answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, converted to a slow vesting stream, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Work waits on the canyon until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the bridge of the next round. Reaching the lotus of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
